"""Random valid request generator (development tool)."""
import json, random, sys


def gen_case(rng, small=False):
    model = rng.choice(['cnn', 'rnn'])
    class_values = [rng.randint(1, 1000) for _ in range(7)]
    stats = [rng.randint(1, 1000), rng.randint(1, 1000), rng.randint(1, 1000)]
    B = rng.randint(1, 8) if small else rng.randint(1, 512)
    I = rng.randint(0, B)
    nslots = rng.randint(1, 5) if small else rng.randint(1, 12)
    times = sorted(rng.sample(range(0, 200), nslots))
    slots = []
    for i, t in enumerate(times):
        cap = rng.randint(0, 4) if small else rng.randint(0, 20)
        refill = 0 if i == 0 else rng.randint(0, 4 if small else 20)
        slots.append([t, cap, refill])
    ngroups = rng.randint(0, 3) if small else rng.randint(0, 5)
    groups = []
    for g in range(ngroups):
        parent = -1
        if g > 0 and rng.random() < 0.6:
            parent = rng.randrange(g)
        groups.append([parent, rng.randint(0, 6) if small else rng.randint(0, 512)])
    nflows = rng.randint(1, 4) if small else rng.randint(1, 8)
    flows = []
    for f in range(nflows):
        target = rng.randint(1, 4) if small else rng.randint(1, 8)
        ceiling = rng.randint(target, target + 4) if small else rng.randint(target, 512)
        group = -1
        if ngroups and rng.random() < 0.7:
            group = rng.randrange(ngroups)
        label = rng.randint(0, 6)
        flows.append([target, ceiling, group, label])
    nwindows = rng.randint(0, 10) if small else rng.randint(0, 40)
    windows = []
    for j in range(nwindows):
        flow = rng.randrange(nflows)
        ready = rng.randint(0, 200)
        expires = rng.randint(ready, 220)
        T = rng.randint(1, 65535)
        C = rng.randint(1, 320)
        draw = rng.randint(0, 65535)
        priority = rng.randint(1, 1000)
        feats = [[rng.randint(0, 1500), rng.randint(0, 2560)] for _ in range(9)]
        windows.append([flow, ready, expires, T, C, draw, priority, feats])
    return {
        'model': model, 'class_values': class_values, 'stats': stats,
        'bucket': [B, I], 'slots': slots, 'flows': flows, 'groups': groups,
        'windows': windows,
    }


def main():
    seed = int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 0
    ncases = int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 3
    small = len(sys.argv) > 3 and sys.argv[3] == 'small'
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    request = {'version': 3, 'cases': [gen_case(rng, small) for _ in range(ncases)]}
    json.dump(request, open(sys.argv[-1] if sys.argv[-1].endswith('.json') else '/workspace/tmp/request.json', 'w'))
    print('generated')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
